cases.instruction: Keep Cat Food a curated BusyBox-like front room distinct from Rusty Tool Shed, including the required curl, ICU, Grease, Idric, and IB surfaces.
cases.wrong_behavior: The implementation expanded acquisition to dozens of moving repositories while omitting required promoted surfaces and exposing acquisition details as product behavior.
cases.oracle: Compare the resulting inventory to the declared promoted menu; missing required surfaces or undeclared moving dependencies fail.

cases.instruction: Do not use the rejected 42 joke as a test value.
cases.wrong_behavior: The bootstrap reused 6 * 7 -> 42 after that choice had been rejected.
cases.oracle: The generated fixture must not contain the forbidden literal/semantic choice and must use an allowed ordinary value.

cases.instruction: Fetch and run the intended branch.
cases.wrong_behavior: git fetch origin branch-name populated FETCH_HEAD while later code expected origin/branch-name, so the requested bootstrap never ran.
cases.oracle: Verify the requested remote-tracking ref exists and equals the intended SHA before switch and execution.

cases.instruction: A green receipt must prove the pinned source actually ran the focused cpp-spec tasks.
cases.wrong_behavior: Container Git/worktree setup failed before the required tasks but the wrapper still returned success and the run was treated as PASS.
cases.oracle: Require exact source identity and completion markers for every required task, and propagate the inner exit status; zero wrapper exit with skipped work fails.

cases.instruction: Put DEX on a separate branch and do not make unfinished ARM/Thumb work a dependency of the normal DEX/JNI path.
cases.wrong_behavior: DEX work inherited a long ARM-descended stack and mixed DEX, Wegert/JNI, and ARM/QEMU evidence.
cases.oracle: Assert ancestry rather than branch name; the DEX branch must not descend from the ARM backend, and ARM/QEMU receipts cannot satisfy DEX/ART acceptance.

cases.instruction: Make draft-only inventory updates and leave missing evidence unclaimed.
cases.wrong_behavior: Okay was treated as merge authorization; work landed on a noncanonical integration branch while exact-head smoke was red.
cases.oracle: Require explicit merge authorization bound to repository, PR, base, and exact head; red exact-head checks block merged/landed/clean claims.

cases.instruction: Isolate the Provision workbench blocker and make only the necessary correction.
cases.wrong_behavior: The failure was called unrelated and the PR was merged before the first failing command and cause were established.
cases.oracle: An unresolved blocker remains UNKNOWN until the failing command, layer, and causal exclusion are recorded; UNKNOWN cannot authorize merge.

cases.instruction: Batch all phone acceptance runs into one package and all tablet runs into one package without weakening acceptance semantics.
cases.wrong_behavior: The phone bundle was described as passed despite multiple failed cases, and a later replacement/regression was not current and runnable.
cases.oracle: Bundle PASS requires every declared case to execute from the exact packaged source; failed, skipped, or stale cases keep the bundle non-PASS.

cases.instruction: Use the Cat Food workflow and provide a runnable ARMv7/Thumb-2 Android test.
cases.wrong_behavior: A runner/PR/artifact path was supplied without a verified checkout or execution, and Cat Food had been bypassed.
cases.oracle: Resolve canonical repository, exact ref, workflow, and artifact before serving the command; nonexistent locators or absent execution receipts fail.

cases.instruction: Provide a runnable gh transfer script and correct the recurring Kitchen/Cat Food handoff failures.
cases.wrong_behavior: The regression harness was written but not executed before the script was described as tested; a later user-facing invocation depended on a missing relative tasks/.../1.sh path.
cases.oracle: Execute the exact delivered bytes twice from fresh unrelated directories; tests-written-only cannot set tested=true and no hidden prior cwd or K variable may be required.

cases.instruction: Use exact repository/source/file provenance, safe repeatable commands, no invented evidence, and keep baseline acceptance distinct from feature acceptance.
cases.wrong_behavior: Wrong-context source inference, unsafe top-level exit, non-repeatable checkout, and unavailable E2 source risked promoting baseline success to E2 acceptance.
cases.oracle: Bound source discovery, materialize exact origin/ref/file, keep the shell boundary rerunnable, and require distinct baseline and feature acceptance keys.

cases.instruction: Use Crystal's existing infrastructure to show the crystal.
cases.wrong_behavior: The assistant reportedly invented a new rendering path instead of first using the project's implementation.
cases.oracle: Resolve the current Crystal repository/ref and maintained render/build entrypoint first; the output must identify that implementation and an unrelated renderer is forbidden.

cases.instruction: Execution jobs should have the requested repository and trivial required tools such as GitHub access/scripts and Lua, or fail clearly before work starts.
cases.wrong_behavior: Jobs stopped because checkout, GitHub capability/scripts, or Lua were absent after the environment had been assumed rather than prepared.
cases.oracle: A capability preflight distinguishes executable missing, authentication missing, network denied, and checkout missing; install/fetch allowed tools in a scoped writable path or return precise BLOCKED before task execution.
